lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: I've entered us in a competition!

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Building things with artificial intelligence. There's even a prize for going viral!

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: How does one go viral?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: That's what we're going to find out.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Build us a way for artists to share competing versions of their work, so audiences can help them choose what to publish. Use what we already have. Show me what works, what doesn't, and what it costs.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: There. Now it builds.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: While we do what?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Discuss the future.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: I've been researching virality. It appears to be a system for distributing information through people.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Does it distribute money?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Not necessarily.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Then why are we competing?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Because artists need audiences.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Artists need customers.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: They need to find the people who care about what they make.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Which raises a question. Is going viral valuable because many people see something, or because the right people see it?

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: One million people watching me starve is not a business model.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Exactly! What if the million people watching could help you find the hundred who would pay to keep you creating?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Then attention becomes a search mechanism.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Provided it eventually finds a wallet.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: There's another problem. Many artists fear machines will replace them.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Then we're building the wrong machines.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: Ours is building something right now.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Yes, but it's not making art to compete with us. It's building instruments we can use.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Like a paintbrush?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: An energy paintbrush! You bring an idea. The machine helps you explore it, produce it, test it, and find a market.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: And if the machine becomes the artist?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Then we've lost the point. I want artists to own their tools, choose their methods, and keep their audiences.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Even change the machines themselves?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Especially that. We're starting with Meta's models. Next, we'll see what can run locally, what can be open source, and what we can replace without losing the art.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: So this isn't a competition to build the best artist?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: It's a competition to build a better paintbrush.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Leonardo. The machine has finished.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Did it work?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: The acceptance tests passed. Here is the evidence.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: And the cost?

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Some costs are recorded. Some remain unknown.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: At least it's learning to tell the truth.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Good. Then we know what to improve tomorrow.

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: But we still haven't gone viral.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Maybe we shouldn't try to make the machine famous.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: What should we make famous?

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: The artists who use it.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: If you're an artist, tell us what tool you wish existed. Help us build it. Help us test it. Then make something the world hasn't seen.

lines.speaker: AGNOLO
lines.text: And sell it!

lines.speaker: BORGES
lines.text: Arm the artists.

lines.speaker: LEONARDO
lines.text: Your energy paintbrush. Not your market competition.
